parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries no participating member records (members: []), no shared field count, no Jaccard similarity score, and no differing_slots — all structural_evidence fields are null. Without any grounded field-overlap or shape evidence, there is no basis to recommend a refactor between PlaycutDetailViewPresented__Metadata in UIEvents.swift and PlaycutMetadata in PlaycutMetadata.swift. The subset-pairs signal alone, absent supporting structural data, cannot justify coupling an analytics event type to a metadata model type.
